lines.text: Ethan promises to sing of the LORD's loving devotion forever, and the LORD swore to David that his offspring would endure.
The LORD stills the raging sea, crushed Rahab, and made north and south, and Sinai and Hermon shout for joy.
The LORD anointed David with sacred oil and promised to set his hand over the sea and the rivers.
If David's sons forsake the law, the LORD will punish them with the rod, yet He will swear by His kingdom not to lie to David.
Ethan says the LORD has cast the king's throne to the ground, then asks how long He will hide Himself, and closes by blessing the LORD forever.
